title: WorkflowDefinition
description: Defines a named, versioned workflow as a directed graph of agent nodes. Stored as YAML in recipes/workflows/; validated by mini-ork on load.

version.description: Semantic or sequential version string, e.g. '1.0.0' or '0009'.

task_class.description: The task_class this workflow serves (must match a task_class.schema.json name).

nodes.description: Agent nodes in this workflow. Each node maps to a single agent invocation.

edges.description: Directed edges connecting nodes. The graph must be a DAG (no cycles).

rollback_strategy.description: Name of the rollback node to invoke if a hard-fail gate fires. Must reference a node name with type 'rollback'.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this workflow accomplishes.

dispatch_mode.description: Default dispatch mode when a node does not override it.

max_self_correction_iterations.description: Maximum bounded repair iterations for this workflow.

recursion.description: Optional bounded recursion configuration for recursive recipes.

source_artifact.description: Named final artifact used by publishing or review recipes.

human_decision_artifact.description: Artifact that records a human approval or decision boundary.

selected_option_artifact.description: Artifact that records the option selected after a human decision gate.

name.description: Unique node identifier within this workflow.

model_lane.description: Model or lane hint, e.g. 'opus', 'sonnet', 'haiku', 'glm', 'kimi'. Resolved against agent_version registry at runtime.

dispatch_mode.description: How this node's work units are dispatched: serial (one by one), parallel (all at once), partitioned (sharded by input key), speculative (race N copies; first wins).

prompt_ref.description: Path (relative to repo root) or key of the prompt template for this node.

verifier_ref.description: Recipe-relative deterministic verifier script for verifier nodes.

timeout_minutes.description: Hard timeout for this node in minutes. 0 = inherit workflow default.

retries.description: How many times to retry this node on failure before escalating.

partition_key.description: Artifact or item key used to partition this node's work.

requires_capabilities.description: Provider capabilities required by this node.

tools.description: Recipe-declared harness tools, optionally grouped by native and MCP capability.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this node does; used in the DAG and in the node prompt when no prompt_ref is given.

mcp_servers.description: Names of MCP servers this node may use, resolved against the MCP registry (see docs/CONFIG.md). The union of these and any tools.mcp grants is what the node is allowed to reach; nothing else is visible to it.

skills.description: Names of skills this node may use, resolved against the skill registry. A skill not named here is not available to the node.

agent_doc.description: Path to an agent-instruction document injected into this node's dispatch.

env.description: Environment variables this node needs, declared by the recipe. A value may be a ${NAME} reference resolved at the node boundary from the secret store, or null to declare the variable absent for this node. The operator's run-scoped config/env.yaml overrides these.

transform.description: Registered deterministic transform identifier; required for transform nodes.

strict_handshake.description: Disable artifact-based completion; the agent self-report is the deliverable. When false (default), a researcher/implementer node whose declared output artifacts are fresh, non-empty and parse completes even if dispatch returned non-zero.

inputs.description: Typed artifact input ports keyed by input name.

outputs.description: Typed artifact output ports. Each output declares name, path, kind, and optional visibility.

retry.description: Per-node RetryPolicy for infra-level attempts (transient infrastructure failures only). Defaults mirror LangGraph's current RetryPolicy. The retry block governs infra attempts on this node; a `retries` edge still governs revise rounds — the two caps compose independently. On terminal failure an ERROR checkpoint row is persisted so the P1.2/P1.3 resume path re-dispatches the node.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts including the first. Default matches LangGraph's RetryPolicy.

initial_interval.description: Seconds to wait before the first retry. Default matches LangGraph's RetryPolicy.

backoff_factor.description: Multiplier on the previous interval after each attempt. Default matches LangGraph's RetryPolicy.

max_interval.description: Upper bound (seconds) on the wait between retries. Default matches LangGraph's RetryPolicy.

jitter.description: Apply bounded jitter to each wait interval. Default matches LangGraph's RetryPolicy.

from.description: Source node name (must match a node.name in this workflow).

to.description: Target node name (must match a node.name in this workflow).

edge_type.description: `depends_on`, `retries` and `escalates_to` have runtime meaning; `supplies_context_to`, `verifies`, `blocks`, `human_decision_gate` and `verifies_user_choice` are deprecated aliases of `depends_on` (2026-10) and will be removed.

condition.description: Edge-activation predicate. A plain string is treated as a legacy marker (ignored by the runtime). An object is a jsonschema-backed predicate evaluated against the source node's output artifact (F5/F6 of p1-1-condition-edges): the predicate fires when `jsonschema.validate(resolve(pointer, output_json), match)` succeeds (or fails when `negate: true`). Currently consumed on `retries` edges only; the rc channel stays authoritative on every other edge type.

oneOf.description: Legacy string form. Preserved so existing recipes that declare `condition: pass` / `condition: fail` on `depends_on` / `escalates_to` edges keep compiling. The runtime does not act on it.
jsonschema-backed predicate evaluated on the source node's output artifact (F5 of p1-1-condition-edges). Compile-time errors: unknown keys, non-string pointer, non-dict match, non-bool negate (C2).

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the source node's output artifact JSON. Empty pointers are rejected at compile time (they would match the whole document by accident).

match.description: JSON Schema fragment validated against the resolved pointer value. The runtime uses jsonschema's Draft7 validator.

negate.description: Optional. When true, the predicate fires when `jsonschema.validate` FAILS (or when the pointer resolves to nothing). Default false.

from_output.description: Producer output port for an explicit artifact handoff.

to_input.description: Consumer input port for an explicit artifact handoff.

recursive.description: Marks a bounded recursive control edge excluded from DAG readiness ordering.

max_rounds.description: retries edges only: maximum revise rounds this edge may fire (compiler default 2)
